full_name: Stochastic Accelerated Gradient Descent for Composite Convex Stochastic Optimization
source_reference: Lan, First-order and Stochastic Optimization Methods for Machine Learning, Springer 2020 (Theorem 4.4)

problem.description: Composite convex stochastic optimization over a closed convex set

variable_space.math: X \subseteq \mathbb{R}^m \text{ closed convex}; \; f(x) = \mathbb{E}[F(x, \xi)]; \; h : X \to \mathbb{R} \text{ simple convex}

assumptions.name: Curvature model
assumptions.math: \mu V(x, y) \le f(y) - f(x) - \langle f'(x), y - x \rangle \le \frac{L}{2} \|y - x\|^2 + M \|y - x\|, \quad \forall x, y \in X

assumptions.name: Distance generating function
assumptions.math: v : X \to \mathbb{R} \text{ is continuously differentiable and 1-strongly convex w.r.t. } \|\cdot\|; \; V(x, z) = v(z) - [v(x) + \langle \nabla v(x), z - x \rangle]

steps.name: Stochastic prox update
steps.math: x_t = \operatorname{argmin}_{x \in X} \left\{ \gamma_t \left[ \langle G(\underline{x}_t, \xi_t), x \rangle + h(x) + \mu V(\underline{x}_t, x) \right] + V(x_{t-1}, x) \right\}

proof.description: Apply Lemma 4.4 with z = x_t to bound Psi(x_tilde_t) using the composite upper model, then apply Lemma 3.5 to the prox update (4.2.6)
Derive the one-step recursion (Proposition 4.2) using d_t = x_t - x_{t-1}^+, strong convexity of V, and the completion-of-squares inequality
Divide by Gamma_t and telescope over t = 1 to k using the recurrence Gamma_t = (1 - alpha_t) Gamma_{t-1} (Proposition 4.3)
Use the identity sum alpha_t / Gamma_t = 1 / Gamma_k (Eq. 4.2.28), Jensen's inequality via convexity of l_Psi, and the monotonicity condition (4.2.22) to telescope the V-terms
Take expectation: E[<delta_t, x^* - x_{t-1}^+> | xi_{[t-1]}] = 0 by the martingale property (Eq. 4.2.32), E[||delta_t||_*^2] <= sigma^2, drop non-negative V(x_k, x*)

key_lemmas.name: Lemma 3.5
key_lemmas.statement_math: \text{Let } p : X \to \mathbb{R} \text{ be convex, } \tilde{x}, \tilde{y} \in X, \; \mu_1, \mu_2 \ge 0. \text{ If } \hat{u} \in \operatorname{Argmin}_{u \in X} \{ p(u) + \mu_1 V(\tilde{x}, u) + \mu_2 V(\tilde{y}, u) \}, \text{ then } p(\hat{u}) + \mu_1 V(\tilde{x}, \hat{u}) + \mu_2 V(\tilde{y}, \hat{u}) \le p(u) + \mu_1 V(\tilde{x}, u) + \mu_2 V(\tilde{y}, u) - (\mu_1 + \mu_2) V(\hat{u}, u), \; \forall u \in X
key_lemmas.role: Provides the composite prox inequality that converts the prox update (4.2.6) into a descent bound with a negative Bregman term

proof.description: Write the first-order optimality condition for the argmin defining u_hat
proof.math: \langle p'(\hat{u}) + \mu_1 \nabla V(\tilde{x}, \hat{u}) + \mu_2 \nabla V(\tilde{y}, \hat{u}), u - \hat{u} \rangle \ge 0, \quad \forall u \in X

proof.description: Use the Bregman three-point identity V(x, u) = V(x, u_hat) + <nabla V(x, u_hat), u - u_hat> + V(u_hat, u) for each center x_tilde and y_tilde
proof.math: V(\tilde{x}, u) = V(\tilde{x}, \hat{u}) + \langle \nabla v(\hat{u}) - \nabla v(\tilde{x}), u - \hat{u} \rangle + V(\hat{u}, u)

proof.description: Combine the optimality condition with the three-point identities and convexity of p to obtain the result
proof.math: p(\hat{u}) + \mu_1 V(\tilde{x}, \hat{u}) + \mu_2 V(\tilde{y}, \hat{u}) \le p(u) + \mu_1 V(\tilde{x}, u) + \mu_2 V(\tilde{y}, u) - (\mu_1 + \mu_2) V(\hat{u}, u)

key_lemmas.name: Lemma 4.4
key_lemmas.statement_math: \text{Let } \tilde{x}_t := (1 - \alpha_t) \tilde{x}_{t-1} + \alpha_t x_t \text{ for } \alpha_t \in [0,1], \; (\tilde{x}_{t-1}, x_t) \in X \times X. \text{ Then } \Psi(\tilde{x}_t) \le (1 - \alpha_t) \Psi(\tilde{x}_{t-1}) + \alpha_t [f(z) + \langle f'(z), x_t - z \rangle + h(x_t)] + \frac{L}{2} \|\tilde{x}_t - z\|^2 + M \|\tilde{x}_t - z\|, \quad \forall z \in X
key_lemmas.role: Provides the composite upper model bound for Psi(x_tilde_t) that initiates the one-step recursion

proof.description: Use x_tilde_t = (1-alpha_t) x_tilde_{t-1} + alpha_t x_t and convexity of f to split f(z) + <f'(z), x_tilde_t - z> into a convex combination at x_tilde_{t-1} and x_t
proof.math: f(z) + \langle f'(z), \tilde{x}_t - z \rangle = (1 - \alpha_t)[f(z) + \langle f'(z), \tilde{x}_{t-1} - z \rangle] + \alpha_t [f(z) + \langle f'(z), x_t - z \rangle]

proof.description: Apply the curvature model (4.2.2) to upgrade f(z) + <f'(z), x_tilde_t - z> into an upper bound on f(x_tilde_t), then add h(x_tilde_t) <= (1-alpha_t)h(x_tilde_{t-1}) + alpha_t h(x_t) by convexity
proof.math: \Psi(\tilde{x}_t) \le (1 - \alpha_t) \Psi(\tilde{x}_{t-1}) + \alpha_t [f(z) + \langle f'(z), x_t - z \rangle + h(x_t)] + \frac{L}{2} \|\tilde{x}_t - z\|^2 + M \|\tilde{x}_t - z\|
